paper_id: FLASH_ Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Learning at Scale
title: FLASH: Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Learning at Scale
motivation: 现有FL研究普遍采用模拟评估，忽略设备硬件差异与动态状态，导致算法在实际部署中的效果未知。
problem_framing: 首次基于136k真实智能手机数据，系统测量异构性（硬件异构+状态异构）对FL基本算法、进阶算法及系统配置的量化影响。
key_insight: 状态异构比硬件异构对准确率的负面影响更大（9.5% vs 0.4%），且异构性使现有进阶算法的优化效果大幅折损（q-FedAvg方差降低效果下降17.5%）。
method_signature: 构建异构感知的FL模拟平台FLASH，基于真实设备状态轨迹与硬件容量数据，对比异构/非异构设置下的算法性能差异。
evaluation_criteria: 收敛准确率、每轮训练时间、压缩率、跨设备准确率方差等多维度指标。
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 梯度压缩算法在异构环境下收敛时间延长2.5×，client-selection算法的选优效果在异构下降低73.9%，现有算法在真实场景收益大幅缩水。
evidence_for_taste: most FL researchers take a simulation approach
ignore heterogeneity and make an overly idealistic assumption
the impact of heterogeneity has not yet been systematically demonstrated
what is more, since most research efforts have not accessed real-world large-scale FL systems
they usually subconsciously set the reporting deadline to a very loose value
subconsciously set the reporting fraction to 1.0
it hinders FL client-selection algorithms from selecting wanted clients
one could simply choose a loose enough deadline
one needs to adjust them carefully
state heterogeneity has more influence over the accuracy drop than hardware heterogeneity
thinking_moves: 将现实工程问题（异构设备丢包/退出的比例）转化为可量化指标（accuracy drop、convergence time multiplier）
先构建异构感知平台，再系统地解耦硬件异构与状态异构的各自贡献（9.5% vs 0.4%）
以消融对比（heterogeneity-aware vs unaware）揭示现有算法在理想假设下的收益被高估
从宏观结果（算法有效/无效）深入微观机制（device failure 11.6%、participant bias top 30%贡献86%）
承认现有模拟方法的根本缺陷：researchers没有接触真实大规模FL系统，只能做ideal假设
